_comment: #253 CANCEL leg: the browser file chooser opens (real tap) and is dismissed with no file (runner --import-cancel). Contract: save_import_cancelled, NO refusal toast, NO game_loaded, settings still open, state untouched. Natively (emulated tap, headless arm) the newest export imports instead, so this script is WEB-ONLY: run_web_qa.sh save_port_web_cancel 9 --skip-export --touch --device=iphone --import-cancel.

steps._comment: == EXPORT == pause -> Settings (row index 7) -> down x14 to 'Export Save' (index 14). GH#386 (v0.19 L5) regrouped the settings ROWS gameplay-first, so the save-file pair sits two rows further down than the append-order it landed in; nothing else in this script moved.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: #253 WEB ARM. Rows are 1-based like click_settings_row: 15 = Export Save, 16 = Import Save... (the keyboard idiom in save_port_loop moves down 14 then 1). Export on the web is a blob download the runner captures; the tap is a REAL browser touch so the import's file input opens inside a user gesture -- the exact condition mobile Safari/Chrome enforce and the engine-injected keyboard confirm cannot satisfy.
